hero.title: Me. <shimmer>Love.</shimmer> Me.
hero.text: Our name says it all. MELOVME is a reminder to pause, care for yourself, and celebrate the person you are — one soft, fragrant ritual at a time.

whoWeAre.imageAlt: MELOVME Body Lotion among fresh leaves and jasmine
whoWeAre.title: Premium care, rooted in nature.
whoWeAre.paragraph1: MELOVME is a premium body-care identity built around the idea of self-love and personal care. We believe that the products you reach for every day should feel just as special as the moments you save them for.
whoWeAre.paragraph2: Our signature droplet represents what we stand for — skincare, hydration and nourishment. Our warm chocolate and soft ivory tones reflect the natural, sophisticated experience we bring to every bottle and box.
